From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@nimbuscloud.com>

Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@nimbuscloud.com>
Date: 2028-07-26T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Subcontractor authorization and DPA addendum — potential order form impact

Hi Vivek / Connor,

Following up on our earlier call — Nimbus is planning to engage DataStream Analytics, Inc. as a downstream subprocessor for log aggregation and analytics (scope: application logs, anonymized usage metrics). Per our MSA flowdown obligations we need to: 1) provide a subcontractor notice, 2) execute the attached DPA addendum that flows down obligations to DataStream, and 3) update the Order Form if there are any cost/pricing operational impacts.

I attached the following for your review: Nimbus_Subproc_List_20280721.csv (subprocessor details), DPA_Addendum_v2_redline.pdf (our proposed addendum with annotations), and an OrderForm_ChangeDraft.docx that reflects a minimal order-form annex.

Timebox: Can you confirm acceptance or flag any legal/procurement objections by EOD Tue 2028-08-02? If accepted we will issue a DocuSign envelope (link below) for the DPA addendum. If Redwood requires customer-facing notices or an updated order form, please call that out so Contracts can triage.

DocuSign (preview): https://app.docusign.com/qs-example/abcdef123456

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Senior Contracts Manager, NimbusCloud
attachments: Nimbus_Subproc_List_20280721.csv, DPA_Addendum_v2_redline.pdf, OrderForm_ChangeDraft.docx
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2028-07-26T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Subcontractor authorization and DPA addendum — potential order form impact

Elena — thanks for the heads up and the attachments. Looping in Legal (Kimberly) and Procurement (Marissa) to review the redlines and check for any order-form/PO impacts.

Quick asks from our side:
- Can Nimbus confirm DataStream's primary processing location (US only, or US + EU)? We need that for data residency mapping.
- Please confirm that DataStream will be contractually bound to the DPA addendum (no later amendments that carve out flowdown).
- If DataStream will have access to any unredacted PII or customer-controlled data, flag that explicitly — that would change our evidence requirements.

Kimberly / Marissa — please see attached redline. Can Legal advise on clauses we must insist on (audit rights, liability carveouts, deletion rules) and Procurement call out any PO/order-form changes or pricing pass-throughs?

Cheers,
Vivek
VP, Strategic Partnerships — Redwood Inference

Date: 2028-07-27T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Subcontractor authorization and DPA addendum — legal redline notes

Vivek / Elena — I reviewed the DPA_Addendum_v2_redline.pdf and the subproc list. High level: we can accept DataStream as a subprocessor provided the addendum is amended along three lines below. Please see my suggested language (I attached a pdf with inline redlines).

1) Explicit flowdown and primary/secondary liability — add language that the subcontractor is bound to all DPA obligations and that Nimbus remains fully liable for any subcontractor acts/omissions; no liability cap carveouts for breach relating to security or data subject rights. Suggested clause: "Supplier shall remain fully liable for any acts or omissions of its Subprocessors and shall ensure Subprocessors comply with all obligations set forth in this Addendum."

2) Audit rights & evidence — we require either (a) the subcontractor's current SOC 2 Type II report covering the relevant control period, or (b) in lieu of SOC2, a completed vendor self-attestation questionnaire plus a right for Redwood to request audit evidence with reasonable notice. The redline currently proposes an unacceptably narrow audit window; widen it to 12 months.

3) Data mapping / deletion / return scope — add a clause clarifying what DataStream may retain after termination and a maximum retention period (90 days) for logs that are not required for regulatory obligations. Also ensure DataStream is required to follow our deletion/obligations mapping.

Operational items: please confirm processing regions (US vs EU) — if EU, we'll require SCCs or equivalent and potentially an EU data processing addendum. Also request the SOC2 report (redacted is fine) and the subproc contract snippet where DataStream accepts the DPA flowdown.

Timeline: if Nimbus can provide SOC2 + confirmation of processing regions by EOD Mon 2028-07-31, Legal can sign off on a narrowly amended addendum by 2028-08-02. If additional negotiation is required, allow an extra 3–5 business days.

Attaching: DPA_Addendum_v2_legal_redline.pdf (inline comments).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
attachments: DPA_Addendum_v2_legal_redline.pdf

Subject: RE: Subcontractor authorization and DPA addendum — procurement check

Vivek / Kimberly / Elena — quick procurement check on the Order Form attachment. Two items:

1) Pricing: does Nimbus expect any cost pass-through or surcharge for using DataStream? If yes, we need a pricing annex and PO change; turnaround for a PO amendment is currently ~7 business days once terms are agreed.

2) Term / billing impact: if DataStream's engagement changes invoicing or introduces new billing SKUs, procurement needs to scope that now.

Elena — can you confirm (a) whether DataStream changes pricing or billing, and (b) whether Nimbus needs Redwood to sign any order-form annex beyond the DPA? If there's no pricing impact, we can keep the Order Form annex as a notice-only item.

Deal: NB-4857 — procurement will hold final sign-off pending Legal's approval and confirmation that there are no cost implications.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks all — appreciate the quick review. Answers below and attachments included.

• Processing region: DataStream operates in the US; no EU processing for the scope described (app logs/anonymized metrics).
• SOC2: attaching a redacted SOC2 Type II report (SOC2_TypeII_Report_stub.pdf). DataStream has agreed to provide the relevant subproc contract snippet confirming the flowdown; Contracts will deliver that once we redact commercial rates.
• Pricing: DataStream is engaged by Nimbus; there is NO pricing pass-through to Redwood. Order Form annex is notice-only (no PO or billing changes required).

We will prepare an updated DPA addendum that incorporates Kimberly's three points (liability confirmation, widened audit language, 90-day retention for logs) and send via DocuSign. Target: we will issue the DocuSign envelope by 2028-07-29. Please confirm Redwood is comfortable with the redline language within 48 hours of receiving the updated addendum.

DocuSign (to be issued): https://app.docusign.com/qs-example/abcdef123456

Elena Soto
Senior Contracts Manager, NimbusCloud
